title: 第5章 职业者
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
【咦？这就是上次自曝定住七个美女，之后只分享了蟠桃品尝体验的大神？——回复人：路人甲】
【呵呵，喜闻乐见。——回复人：骄傲的赛亚人王子】
【我“哔”！本大圣惹你了？】
【看见你的名字就想骂，怎么？咬我？我出论坛币，你敢来吗？哦，对了，你被监禁了，遗憾。】
【活该你被万事屋老板坑！】
主世界，开灵仪式进行中……
“这就是贡氏家族的二少爷吗？笔试和模拟试炼的成绩都是第一……不错，没给贡氏家族丢人。”
“哪里哪里，犬子还要多磨砺，巴议员您见笑了。”贡氏家族的家主贡连矜持的说道。
此时在主席台上，城中一些大家族的代表，还有联盟在杜兰城的议会议员们都在座。
虽然在深渊生物的强压下，人类成立了职业者联盟，但也正是因为深渊生物的横行，各城来往不便，在行政领域一向是“地头蛇政治”！
只要不破坏统一战线的大局，联盟对这些“地头蛇”们，也不会过于约束，毕竟这些资源丰厚的“地头蛇”们，也是职业者的重要来源！
只见贡文在宋院长示意后，第一个走到了开灵阵图中央，并且将手放在了中心处的台子上、所放置的“开灵”水晶表面……
整个杜兰城也只有职业者联盟有两块开灵水晶，开灵仪式也是每个人一生中仅有一次的头等大事！
就在贡文的手放在开灵水晶上之后，水晶与法阵闪烁过淡青色的光芒后，只见一个复杂的立体符文，凭空出现在水晶上方……
宋院长见到符文后，满意的说道：“贡文同学开灵成功！觉醒元素系、‘风元素使’职业者！”
万一第一名都没有成功的话，对他来说也是一件晦气的事情。
而贡文在松了口气的同时，也感觉到一阵惋惜，虽然之前他说自己能觉醒“风元素使”就满足了，但是心中未必没有别的想法……
贡氏家族的遗传并不稳定，虽然出过的不少职业者，大部分都是“风元素使”，但也不是没有其他的！
如果我也能够觉醒“空间类”的职业就好了……贡文心里大概是这么想的。
【原来这就是“开灵”，好神奇的样子……】关立远有些紧张的对企鹅说道。

因为接下来就是他比较关心的魏樱樱了。
魏樱樱作为他穿越四个月以来，仅有的两位好友之一，自然会令关立远紧张。
魏樱樱的年纪也比钟离秋和关立远要大两岁，今年十六岁的魏樱樱因为女生发育早，比关立远还要高半头，发育的也比较有规模，有着显眼的淡粉色短发与双眸。
相比于钟离秋，魏樱樱更加沉稳，没有那么多坏脾气，而且也很会为其他人着想。
半个月前魏樱樱就提议让贡文稍微痛快一回，好令关立远能好过一些，不过却被关立远坚定的拒绝了！
就在魏樱樱将手放在水晶上之后，符文凭空出现的一刻，关立远和钟离秋都松了口气……
他们俩大概是学员中，唯一还有闲心担心别人的！
“魏樱樱同学开灵成功！觉醒元素系、‘云元素使’职业者！”宋院长依旧亲自负责着宣布开灵成功的任务。
看着关立远一副激动的样子，同在角落里的其他同学纷纷将他当做傻“哔”……
【云元素？好像比风元素更稀有些吧？】
【的确更稀有，不过这个宇宙的职业者强弱，和稀有、不稀有没有直接关系！很多“稀有”的职业，反而因为前人的经验少，还不如大众化的职业。】企鹅显然也已经了解不少这个宇宙的事情了。
从某种程度上来说，企鹅比关立远听课的时间还多！
关立远现在也已经知道，这个世界的“职业者”，已经有记载的种类，就有数千种之多，不过常见的也就是那几十种，比如“元素系”的土、水、火、风、雷元素使，比如“本体系”的狼斗士、犬斗士、剑斗士，比如“规则系”的各种召唤师，比如“心灵系”的念动力者……
从大类上来分，也就是元素系、本体系、规则系、心灵系。
就在关立远走神的功夫，前十名已经都测试完了，其中前三名全部“开灵”成功时，宋院长笑得好像一朵雏菊，不过之后的七人中只有四人成功，令“雏菊”又有些被爆了的样子……
这章没有结束^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
【Huh? Is this the master who last time revealed that he had seven beautiful women, and then only shared his experience of tasting flat peaches? ——Replyer: Passerby A]
[Haha, I’m glad to hear it. ——Replyer: Proud Saiyan Prince]
【I beep! Did this great sage offend you? 】
[I want to scold you when I see your name, what? Bite me? I offer forum coins, do you dare to come? Oh, by the way, you were imprisoned, sorry. 】
[You deserve to be cheated by the boss of Wanshiwu! 】
In the main world, the spiritual opening ceremony is in progress...
"Is this the second young master of the Gong family? His scores in both the written examination and the mock trial were both first place... Not bad, he didn't embarrass the Gong family."
"What the hell, the dog needs to be tempered even more. Councilman Ba, you are laughing at me." Gong Lian, the head of the Gong family, said reservedly.
At this time, on the rostrum, representatives of some big families in the city and members of the alliance's parliament in Duran City were present.
Although humans have established a professional alliance under the pressure of abyssal creatures, it is precisely because of the rampant abyssal creatures that it is inconvenient to travel between cities. In the administrative field, there has always been "local snake politics"!
As long as the overall situation of the united front is not undermined, the alliance will not be too restrictive on these "local snakes". After all, these "local snakes" with rich resources are also an important source of professionals!
After receiving Dean Song's signal, Gongwen was the first to walk to the center of the Spirit-Opening Array, and placed his hand on the surface of the "Ling-Opening" crystal placed on the table in the center...
In the entire city of Dulan, only the Professional Alliance has two soul-opening crystals, and the soul-opening ceremony is also a top priority that only happens once in everyone's life!
Just after Gongwen put his hand on the spirit-opening crystal, the crystal and the magic circle flashed with light cyan light, and a complex three-dimensional rune appeared out of thin air above the crystal...
After Dean Song saw the runes, he said with satisfaction: "Student Gongwen successfully opened his spirit! Awakened the elemental system and became the 'Wind Elementalist' professional!"
If he doesn't succeed even in the first place, it will be unlucky for him.
While Gongwen breathed a sigh of relief, he also felt a sense of regret. Although he had previously said that he would be satisfied if he could awaken the "Wind Elementalist", he may not have other thoughts in his heart...
The inheritance of the Gong family is not stable. Although most of the many professionals who have come out are "Wind Elementalists", there are still others!
It would be great if I could also awaken a "space-type" profession... Gongwen probably thought so.
[So this is "opening the spirit", it looks so magical...] ​​Guan Liyuan said to Penguin nervously.
Because next is Wei Yingying, whom he is more concerned about.
Wei Yingying was one of the only two friends he had in the four months since he traveled through time, which naturally made Guan Liyuan nervous.
Wei Yingying is also two years older than Zhong Liqiu and Guan Liyuan. Wei Yingying, who is sixteen years old this year, is half a head taller than Guan Liyuan because girls develop early, and her growth is relatively large, with conspicuous short light pink hair and eyes.
Compared with Zhong Liqiu, Wei Yingying is more calm, less bad-tempered, and is also very considerate of others.
Half a month ago, Wei Yingying suggested that Gongwen should have some fun so that Guan Liyuan could feel better, but Guan Liyuan firmly refused!
The moment Wei Yingying put her hand on the crystal and the symbol appeared in the sky, both Guan Liyuan and Zhong Liqiu breathed a sigh of relief...
The two of them are probably the only ones among the students who still have time to worry about others!
"Student Wei Yingying successfully opened her spirit! Awakened the elemental system and became a 'Cloud Elementalist' professional!" Dean Song was still personally responsible for the task of announcing the successful opening of her spirit.
Seeing Guan Liyuan's excited expression, other students in the corner all thought he was stupid...
[Cloud element? It seems rarer than the wind element, right? 】
[It is indeed rarer, but the strength of professionals in this universe depends on whether it is rare or not.Is there a direct relationship? Many "rare" professions are not as popular as popular professions because predecessors have little experience. ] Penguin obviously already knows a lot about this universe.
To some extent, Penguin spent more time listening to lectures than Guan Liyuan!
Guan Liyuan now also knows that there are thousands of recorded types of "professionals" in this world, but the common ones are just a few dozen, such as the earth, water, fire, wind, and thunder elementalists of the "elemental system", such as wolf fighters, dog fighters, sword fighters of the "original system", various summoners of the "rules system", such as telekinesis users of the "psychic system"...
From the broad categories, they are the element system, the main system, the rule system, and the spiritual system.
Just when Guan Liyuan was distracted, the top ten had already been tested, and when the top three were all successful in "opening their spirits", Dean Song smiled like a daisy, but only four of the next seven succeeded, making "Daisy" look a little bit exploded again...
